newsitem.title: USA: Staples CEO confident of 30 pct EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Staples CEO confident of 30 pct EPS growth.

text.p: Staples Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Thomas Stemberg said Tuesday he was confident the company would deliver on its target of more than $4 billion in revenue and 30 percent growth in earnings per share for its current fiscal year.

"We're comfortable to say that we really will exceed $4 billion, as proposed, and deliver on 30 percent growth in EPS," he said in a presentation to a Montgomery Securities investment conference in San Francisco.

For the fiscal year ended February 3, Staples posted earnings per share before extraordinary credit of $0.46 on sales of $3.07 billion. That compares with EPS of $0.28 on $2.00 billion in sales a year earlier.

A month ago, Staples and Office Depot announced a definitive agreement to merge in a tax-free exchange of shares. The combined company would have more than 1,100 office-supply superstores, to be renamed Staples The Office Depot. Each company currently operates more than 500 stores.
The agreement was subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
